meta.index: The influence index, from 0 to 100, is an editorial estimate of each country's share of global wine prestige and trade value at the time. There's no consistent market data reaching back to Rome, so treat the lines as a story told in shape, not a measurement.
meta.axis: The time axis is compressed before 1500 so the busy modern centuries have room to breathe. The Southern Hemisphere begins with the first colonial plantings in the 1540s.
